title.en: Automatically rescue invalid or nonconforming data with Databricks Auto Loader or Delta Live Tables

summary.en: Invalid or nonconforming data can crash workloads dependent on specific data formats. Best practices recommend filtering such data at ingestion to improve end-to-end resilience, ensuring no data is lost or missed.

rationale.en: Reliable data processing requires explicit quality, schema and ownership boundaries. Layering, transactional tables and rescued records serve different purposes, but each must make invalid, stale or competing data visible instead of hiding it.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Databricks/workspaces. Specific focus: Rescued ingestion records.
Identify authoritative datasets, supported table or ingestion features, schema contracts and downstream quality requirements.

applicability.en: Workspace configuration, external data and job progress have separate recovery boundaries. Delta time travel depends on retained history and data files; it is not an unlimited independent backup.

title.en: Monitor your Azure SQL Database in Near Real-Time to Detect Reliability Incidents

title.en: Maintain singleton pattern in your client

summary.en: Partitioning data improves scalability, reduces contention, and optimizes performance. Implement data partitioning to divide data by usage pattern.

rationale.en: Partitioning distributes data and load but changes transaction, consistency and recovery boundaries. A useful partition strategy avoids hot keys and makes cross-partition operations and failures explicit.

Use actual access patterns, tenant-independent workload characteristics, skew and supported storage transaction semantics.

title.en: Verify current Event Hubs zone eligibility and client continuity

summary.en: Event Hubs zone support is automatically provided in supported regions subject to tier/capacity prerequisites. Standard and Premium need no extra zone setting; Dedicated requires at least three CUs. Historical portal/IaC defaults are not the current decision rule.
summary.ko: Event Hubs는 계층과 용량 조건에 따라 지원 지역에서 자동 영역 지원을 제공합니다. Standard와 Premium은 별도 영역 설정이 없고 Dedicated는 최소 3개 CU가 필요합니다. 과거 포털과 IaC 기본값 차이를 현재 판단 기준으로 쓰지 않습니다.

benefits.en: Correct tier and capacity interpretation supports zonal resilience while client retry and checkpoint design preserve processing continuity.

rationale.en: Current Event Hubs reliability documentation describes automatic zone support for namespaces in supported regions, rather than a portal-versus-IaC toggle. Standard and Premium need no extra zone configuration; Dedicated requires at least three capacity units. Events, metadata and configuration are synchronously replicated across zones, but clients still need retries and idempotent checkpoint recovery.

title.en: Use NAT Gateway instead of Outbound Rules for Production Workloads

summary.en: Outbound rules for Standard Public Load Balancer involve manual port allocation for backend pools, limiting scalability and risk of SNAT port exhaustion. NAT Gateway is recommended for its dynamic scaling and secure internet connectivity.

rationale.en: Address space, SNAT ports, interface bandwidth and service connection limits constrain different parts of a network. Plan against peak concurrency, scale and recovery demand using the exact bottleneck named in the recommendation.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers. Specific focus: NAT-based outbound access.
Check service-reserved addresses, growth and upgrade surge, connection reuse and exact tier or subnet limitations.

implementation_steps.en: Identify the actual in-scope Microsoft.App/containerApps objects and read their current Container health probes configuration. Record the scope and observation time; do not infer inventory from this conceptual guide.
Define the failure represented by the signal, configure the supported path or state observation and align its consumer's thresholds and startup grace period.
implementation_steps.ko: 신호가 나타내는 장애를 정의하고 지원되는 경로나 상태 관찰을 구성합니다. 사용하는 쪽의 임계값과 시작 유예 시간을 맞춥니다.

implementation_steps.en: Review the pinned APRL action 'Enable container health probes' against the original description and cited documentation. Prepare a supported, scoped change proposal and rollback; this guide itself does not execute or approve changes.
Prepare independent observations for: Startup, liveness and readiness probe behavior for slow starts and failed dependencies. Resolve unsupported or ambiguous conditions before proposing a change.

verification_steps.en: Inspect and retain source-attributed configuration or workload evidence for: Startup, liveness and readiness probe behavior for slow starts and failed dependencies.
Compare observed signal transitions with actual request behavior during an approved slow-start or failure scenario; verify routing, restart or escalation behavior separately.
verification_steps.ko: 승인된 느린 시작 또는 장애 시나리오에서 신호 변화와 실제 요청 처리를 비교합니다. 라우팅, 재시작 또는 에스컬레이션 동작을 따로 검증합니다.

verification_steps.en: Compare the observed Container health probes behavior with this recommendation's intended mechanism and the original source. Record timestamps, scope, missing coverage and conflicting observations.
Keep the existing automated, manual, blocked or unsupported assessment disposition separate. Missing evidence stays unknown; a diagram, a setting write or API acceptance is not operational success.
verification_steps.ko: 기존의 자동, 수동, blocked 또는 미지원 평가 상태를 별도로 유지합니다. 정보가 없으면 알 수 없음으로 남깁니다. 그림, 설정 쓰기나 API 수락은 운영 성공이 아닙니다.

cautions.en: An overly broad dependency probe can remove every instance at once; a management state of Available is not an application transaction success.
cautions.ko: 범위가 지나치게 넓은 의존성 프로브는 모든 인스턴스를 동시에 제외할 수 있습니다. 관리 상태가 Available이어도 애플리케이션 트랜잭션 성공을 뜻하지는 않습니다.

cautions.en: The pinned APRL description and benefits are English-source metadata with explicit English fallback, not an independently verified Korean translation. Current product support must be checked before use.
cautions.ko: 고정된 APRL 설명과 기대 효과는 영어 대체 표시를 사용하는 원본 메타데이터이며 검증된 한국어 번역이 아닙니다. 사용 전에 현재 제품 지원을 확인해야 합니다.

description.en: Repository-authored conceptual diagram, not an observed deployment or assessment result. A health signal informs routing or lifecycle handling, so its semantics must match the failure it is meant to detect. Process liveness, request readiness, dependency health and management-plane state are different observations.
description.ko: 실제 배포나 평가 결과가 아닌 저장소 작성 개념도입니다. 상태 신호는 라우팅이나 수명 주기 처리에 사용되므로 탐지하려는 장애와 의미가 일치해야 합니다. 프로세스 생존, 요청 처리 준비, 의존 리소스 상태와 관리 상태는 서로 다른 관찰입니다.
